title.narrative: Strengthening control of Tuberculosis ("TB") and HIV/AIDS in the Republic of Armenia

description.narrative: Armenia - TB/HIV - Ministry of Health of the Republic of Armenia - MOH. This program has the following goals: To provide an effective response to HIV, and to set the right conditions for ending AIDS by 2030.. To end tuberculosis as a public health problem in Armenia by 2035 in line with the global End TB Strategy through universal access to quality TB services and integrated people-oriented care with a particular focus on DR-TB. The objectives of this program are: To strengthen uptake, comprehensiveness and quality of HIV-prevention services with a focus on key and other priority populations. To strengthen the uptake, comprehensiveness and quality of HIV testing, treatment and care services – with a view to reaching the 95-95-95 test-treatment goals. To strengthen the availability and use of strategic information for evidence-based decision-making. By 2025, find at least 95% of all people with TB and ensure early detection and diagnosis of all types of the disease. Improve TB treatment outcomes and reach 2025 WHO regional milestone of not less than 80 % treatment success rate in RR/MDR-TB by ensuring universal access to integrated patient-centred quality treatment and care for patients with all forms of TB. By 2025, close the gaps on preventing TB for those most at risk through the rapid scaling up of access to testing for TB infection and provision of preventive treatment to all eligible people
